project.designRead: AI开发者论坛 / AI开发者+零基础用户 / 专业科技感 / 中高信息密度 / 避免彩虹渐变与emoji图标
project.styleDefinitionBrief: 面向AI开发者的专业技术社区，采用Indigo主色的科技感清晰风格，强调信息密度与可信度。

sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: border-led static cards; shadow only for float layers
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: primary indigo fill; secondary ghost; text link
continuityAnchors: Global top navigation with logo, search, nav links, auth avatar across all pages
Indigo primary + neutral surfaces; restrained radius and shadow discipline
Consistent footer with site links and slogan

pages.title: 首页
pages.visualNorthStar: 个性化Feed中枢，清晰展示推荐帖子、版块入口与AI快捷问答，建立社区首页第一印象
pages.compositionPattern: Large / medium / small stacked: hero search + board grid + feed list

pages.title: 版块详情页
pages.visualNorthStar: 单个版块的帖子列表，区分入门/深度分区，突出关注与发帖入口
pages.compositionPattern: Sticky header card + tab switcher + post list with filters

pages.title: 帖子详情页
pages.visualNorthStar: 帖子正文 + AI结构化答案（带来源与置信度）+ 社区补充区，强调答案可追溯
pages.compositionPattern: Single-column reading flow with highlighted AI answer card and reply threads

pages.title: 发帖/提问页
pages.visualNorthStar: 简洁的提问/发帖编辑器，内嵌AI辅助写作工具栏，降低创作门槛
pages.compositionPattern: Centered form card with toolbar and primary publish action

pages.title: 个人主页
pages.visualNorthStar: 用户资料、声望徽章与内容历史，展示社区身份与贡献
pages.compositionPattern: Profile hero + stats row + tabbed history lists

pages.title: 登录/注册页
pages.visualNorthStar: 聚焦的登录/注册卡片，支持第三方授权，降低注册门槛
pages.compositionPattern: Centered auth card with tabbed login/register forms

pages.title: 通知页
pages.visualNorthStar: 按类型分组的互动通知列表，快速定位回复、点赞、采纳、打赏等消息

pages.title: 搜索结果页
pages.visualNorthStar: 全站搜索结果，支持帖子/用户/版块分类，高亮命中沉淀答案
pages.compositionPattern: Search input + category tabs + mixed result list

pages.title: 设置页
pages.visualNorthStar: 账号信息、通知偏好与隐私设置的分栏设置页
